text:
tara: Who thinks we should start a Config Speed Dating event? Each config gets 60s to explain its feelings. :timer_clock:
ben: Love it. Topic for first round: YAML vs JSON - emotional baggage edition. :broken_heart:
lint-bot: lint-bot: ⚠ Warning: `version: 'v1.2'` looks incomplete. Please use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
ami: Someone literally put `version: '0.0.0-very-likely-never'` in prod last week. It had commitment issues. :sweat_smile:
chris: We should also do a compiler roast where errors read out in dramatic Shakespearean monologue. "To parse or not to parse". :performing_arts:
mike: I will DJ. My setlist includes "Segmentation Fault Blues" and "Undefined Reference Tango". :musical_score:
tara: Sample YAML confession for the event:
```yaml
service:
  name: dating-app
  version: "v1 . 0.0"
  note: "I can't decide if I'm major or minor"
```
ben: That spacing is such a mood. Also can we please agree on no trailing commas in YAML after midnight.
lint-bot: lint-bot: Auto-fix suggestion applied to `service.version`: normalized to `1.0.0` by @ami.
ami: I brought stickers: "I survived a bad semver" and "Ask me about my merge conflict". Free at the commons. :sticker:
chris: Quick poll: who wants karaoke with only error messages? react with :microphone: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for never again.
mike: Also kudos to @ben for fixing that weird tab-in-yaml deploy yesterday under 5 minutes. You're the real semver whisperer. :tada:
tara: OK wrap-up: Config Speed Dating at 4pm. Bring snacks, a linter, and your best commit apology. :confetti_ball:
